propositions: A container ticket with no declared file_impact falls back to whole-HEAD invalidation, causing attestation invalidation on every unrelated commit

Container plan-review scope should inherit the union of DIRECT children's file_impact, with a poison rule: if any non-closed child has empty file_impact, inheritance is blocked and the empty set fallback applies
The orchestrator already fetches direct children with their file_impact, so dependency_hashes should accept an optional children parameter threaded through sign_plan_review without new store reads
P9 should extend to surface an advisory (non-blocking) on containers with poisoned inheritance, naming the offending children with empty file_impact
A child editing its file_impact after container review must invalidate the container's attestation via material fingerprint pin drift
Closed children neither contribute files nor poison the union, and grandchildren are excluded because inheritance self-heals only one level deep
